title: statusline r1 AIE: event-driven refresh cost unbounded and uncataloged
description: Round: statusline amendment cold round 1. Lens: ai-engineer (validator pair: platform-engineer). Owner: SO session. Defect: segment refreshes on every conversation event via per-repo subprocess fan-out (bootstrap: 3 crosslink calls per repo, ~1.2s) with no bound, cache, throttle, or declared cost band — the most frequently executed operation escapes Cost is knowable's cost-observability. Citations verified: contract:160 (zero-AI-cost sentence) with :196 (acquisition in effectful shell). Anchors: Status, renderer. Proposed: resolved-candidate. Failure: wall-clock and load on every turn, unobserved, uncontracted.

comments.author: xqjG
comments.content: Fixed in working tree. Segment invocation cost contracted: single snapshot acquisition (not per-field subprocess fan-out — the bootstrap three-calls-per-repo shape named as what it replaces), wall-clock bounded by a declared budget with the number set at phase-1c data authoring alongside the other numbers. Revision: Status bullet + effectful shell (snapshot acquisition for status/statusline named).
